meta.title: Better Workspace
meta.description: Upgrades the sidebar workspace list into a two-layer hierarchy tree (disk nesting by the official owningParentFolder semantics, optional name-slash grouping), explicit empty folders, appearance customization with live preview, and the official add-workspace flow for every backend.

en.settings.appearance.hint: Rows that were never customized use this appearance; the outline ships off on fresh installs — on a clean theme it reads as embossed noise, so turn it on when a background image needs it. Leave the color empty to follow the theme.
en.settings.autoStyle: Auto color & icon for new items
en.settings.autoStyle.hint: When on, every newly created session gets a built-in color and every new workspace also gets an icon. Colors come from 13 fixed slots drawn with shuffle + recent-dedup, so consecutive items never look alike. Every slot ships two colors — a darker one for the light theme, a lighter one for the dark theme — and each clears WCAG normal-text AA (contrast ≥4.5) on its own theme's background; switching themes repaints the same slot automatically, with nothing to redo. Only items created after you turn it on are touched; rows you styled by hand are never overwritten, and turning it off does not undo what was already assigned. Off by default.
en.settings.compactChains.hint: Single-child chains merge into one row; levels with multiple children expand as a tree. Chains re-expand into folder rows while you drag a workspace, so it can drop into any level. State and custom styling persist in this browser.
en.settings.density.hint: Row heights follow the shipped sidebar: Comfortable is the official default; Compact saves vertical space, Roomy adds larger hit targets. Applies immediately, stored in this browser.
en.settings.desc: Workspace tree appearance and folding preferences
en.settings.graft.hint: The 'titles that follow the conversation' experiment renames sessions to names without the '/' group, which dissolves the grouping. On, this view keeps the original '/' prefix and swaps only the last segment (A/xxx becomes A/yyyy). Manual renames are unaffected. On by default.
en.settings.graft.title: Auto titles keep the group prefix
en.settings.rowActions.hint: Show pin / archive quick buttons at the end of a hovered session row, matching the official rows. Off: these actions stay in the menu only. On by default.
en.settings.sessionLimit.hint: An expanded workspace first shows only its most recent sessions, the rest behind one Show-more row; pinned, running and waiting-for-you sessions always stay visible. All = no limit (default).
en.settings.showCount.hint: The shipped sidebar retired the per-workspace session count; turn this on to restore it at the row tail (it yields to the row actions on hover). Off by default.
en.settings.statusPulse.hint: Status dots hidden by collapse (done green / running blue / pending amber) bubble outward: workspace and folder rows breathe on their icon in the status color (custom-glow labels breathe along), session-group rows show a breathing dot; on by default, turn it off here.
en.settings.title: Better Workspaces
en.settings.workspaceGroup.hint: Disk folders: nest only by the official folders (disk directories). Disk + names: layer slash-name groups on top of the disk tree. Names only: group purely by slashes in titles and ignore disk nesting entirely. A previous version's switch state migrates automatically.

en.sync.desc: Appearance customization and toggles live in this device's browser; they exchange with the other surface (web / desktop app) through the host settings store. New edits are written to the host automatically — the other surface just pulls. History created before this version needs one explicit Send.
